title: Resume the original ranged download
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Resume an original artifact after cutover and detect missing, duplicated, changed, unsupported or unverified bytes despite successful responses, within the original UX budget.
preconditions: A modern browser with standard local HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Web Crypto SHA-256.
The fixed 32-byte synthetic artifact and bounded synthetic clock.
No account, server, credentials, framework, Azure connection or dependency installation.
actions: Choose retained bytes, destination response, resume delay, original budget and checksum evidence.
Admit the original prefix, then resume on the synthetic destination.
Inspect byte offsets, actual computed SHA-256, original-clock budget, verdict and user impact.
Reset to exact defaults while retaining the eight newest outcomes and full receipts.
assertions: Correct resumption requests the first missing byte with the original validator.
Every byte occurs once in order and the computed SHA-256 equals the original artifact.
Successful 206 responses with a gap, overlap or changed byte fail.
A successful 200 that ignores Range is unsupported; unsafe append is refused.
The original clock and inclusive deadline are retained across resumption.
Missing checksum evidence is UNKNOWN; known failures take precedence over unknown checks.
Strict input and phase guards reject unsafe or repeated actions.
Reset retains bounded failure history and records unfinished attempts as UNKNOWN.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral RED; before implementation

limits: Synthetic browser lesson, not live HTTP or Azure proof, large-file throughput or production Node.js 24 certification.
Session memory only; page reload clears history.
Unsupported resume is reported, not automatically replaced by a fresh download.
Native B-S044 requires CORE, DATA, HOST, OBJECT, C025, an approved target and a separate native lease.
D-S044 still requires D-S039 and original native acceptance; no source parent is complete.
